findings.summary: Implementation provenance remains incomplete across direct zip import, positive source-checkout identity and duplicate archive-member validation.
findings.evidence: The exact direct wheel passes the new core distribution validator but graph_engineering.adapters import then fails because the adapter validator strictly resolves a zip-member __file__ path. An exact copied source payload outside the repository with the three pinned files and an empty fake .git directory is accepted and resolves an approved implementation digest. Separately, direct zip wheels containing duplicate identical provenance or core-validator members import successfully because _record_resource checks only distribution.files/RECORD multiplicity and not physical archive members.
findings.required_change: Make adapter-package provenance validation zip-import-aware while preserving exact archive, member, RECORD, distribution-root and distribution-identity checks. Positively authenticate the legitimate source checkout using a deterministic repository identity proof rather than a copyable .git marker and three file hashes. For archive distributions, enumerate physical members and require exactly one validator and provenance resource as well as exactly one matching RECORD row before factory issue or adapter call.

Copy the exact source core, adapter, pyproject and build-backend bytes into a manufactured layout with an empty, file-shaped or initialized fake .git marker; every form must reject before implementation provenance, factory issue or adapter call, while the legitimate exact source checkout passes using a positive repository identity proof.

Create zip wheels with duplicate physical graph_engineering/__init__.py or graph_engineering/pyproject.toml members, including identical-byte duplicates with only one RECORD row; each must reject before implementation provenance, factory issue or adapter call.

Retain rejection for entire dist-info absence, zero or duplicate matching distributions, module/distribution-root mismatch, missing provenance or validator resources, missing or duplicate RECORD rows, missing RECORD hashes, resource or RECORD tamper, and distribution name or version mismatch in extracted and direct-zip layouts.

Retain one-field and fully self-consistent re-sign substitutions for implementation digest or ref, capability, operation, policy, registry and installation provenance; all must reject before adapter issue or external call.
Keep the trust validator itself bound in the exact source manifest, WP-07A runtime and source evidence inputs, wheel payload and unique hashed RECORD entry.
